रिंख्, रिंग् (रिंखति, रिंगति)
1 To
crawl, creep.
--2 To go slowly.

रिंख्, रिंग् (रिंखति, रिंगति)
1 To
crawl, creep.
--2 To go slowly.

रिंखणं, रिंगणं
1 Crawling,
creeping (of children who creep on all
fours).
--2 Deviating (from
rectitude), swerving.
